For your own wardrobe or for your business. Choose Personal or Business when you launch the app.

How it works

Your wardrobe. More possibilities.

From the clothes you already own to the pieces and people you discover next.

  1. 01 / Collect

    Build your wardrobe

    Photograph your clothes and tag their category and occasion. Your wardrobe stays on this device, ready to style again.

    Add your pieces ↗
  2. 02 / Style

    Find a fresh combination

    Describe your look, choose a palette, or save Pinterest inspiration. Build outfits from your own clothes and sign in for online styling advice.

    Style an outfit ↗
  3. 03 / Discover

    Plan your next purchase

    Browse independent stores and save product links with sizes, colour notes and target prices. Keep your wishlist and wallet tools together.

    Open your wishlist ↗
  4. 04 / Connect

    Share, sell or donate

    Save your outfits and publish a look to the community. List a piece for sale or donation; listings are reviewed before they appear publicly.

    Explore the closet ↗
  5. 05 / Book

    Bring in a professional

    Request a fashion, makeup or hair appointment. Add your preferred time and brief, then check your booking for confirmation.

    Book a stylist ↗
  6. 06 / Keep

    Make it your everyday companion

    Sign in to manage your profile and wallet, install Looku, and use an optional encrypted backup to protect the wardrobe on your device.

    Open your account ↗

For independent businesses

Your collection. Your own storefront.

Create a home for your brand, make it yours with images and colours, and share your products with the Looku community. Launch the app and choose Business.

  1. 01 / Create

    Set up your store

    Sign in, choose your store name and address, and add a description and contact email. Submit your store for Looku’s review.

    Create a store ↗
  2. 02 / Make it yours

    Build your brand identity

    Add a logo, banner, background and colours. Adjust separate desktop and mobile banner crops and preview the result before saving.

    Manage your branding ↗
  3. 03 / Publish

    Put your collection on display

    Once approved, publish products with photos, descriptions and KES prices. Edit your catalogue, hide a piece or mark it sold out.

    Manage your products ↗
  4. 04 / Grow

    Share your storefront

    Share your public store link and appear in Looku’s store directory. Customers contact you to confirm availability, delivery and payment.

    Explore Looku stores ↗
Your store, your customer relationship.

Store approval comes before publishing products. Your storefront provides your contact details so shoppers can arrange a purchase directly with you.
